text:
Type: two-door storage cabinet
Use: storing dishes, linens, books and media behind doors; living room, dining room, bedroom, hallway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted board with a subtle wood-grain texture, black metal bow handles
Colors: white, black handles
Shape: boxy cabinet with two flat doors under a slim top rail, curved bow handles, overhanging top with a molded edge, grooved corner posts, short square feet, medium visual weight
Feel: homey, fresh, simple, tidy
Goes with: light wood floors, black accents, grey or blue walls; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian living and dining rooms

product.name: BRUSALI
product.description: Adjustable shelves, so you can customise your storage as needed.
